purpose: Separate semantic correspondence from geometry so one host object can be lawfully rendered and operated through unequal projections and scales without becoming several objects.

equation.control_sufficiency_pair: PROJECT(x) = PROJECT(y) AND APERTURE(x) != APERTURE(y) => projection is not control-sufficient for that aperture/property/horizon

laws: Projection or scale changes may reallocate space but do not change facet semantics.
A projection may suppress a channel only by declaring residue.
Unsupported operation or projection paths return SUPPORT=0 with a reason.
Editable projections obey GetPut and PutGet for the edited domain.
A projected operation is lawful only when its canonical counterpart is explicit and the operation square commutes within the declared equivalence.

Control sufficiency is falsifiable by native lawful consequence: if two native states share a projection but differ in the named lawful next aperture or relevant consequence, that projection remains VIEW + explicit RESIDUE for that property/horizon and cannot own effect authority.
A passing finite pair check is only absence of that counterexample for the tested pair; it does not certify global control sufficiency.
Selection and multifocus survive projection and scale changes.
Authority is host-owned and cannot increase through projection.
Physical geometry, fit, load and irreversible actuation are canonical only when supplied by a physical host; screen placement is not evidence of physical truth.
Six offices are one reusable mapping preset, not a required ontology.
Shared HOLD / TURN / RELEASE / TRACE / RETURN verbs are action projections over native operations; they may compress interaction language but never manufacture operation support or authority.

placement.law: placement contains no canonical payload; it points back to facet/object identity

scale_policy.compact: allocate recognition + address; details may become residue/inspector
scale_policy.room: allocate facets to surfaces/volumes while preserving facet ids
scale_policy.physical: bind only through measured physical host addresses

action_projection.law: Shared verbs compress how a carried object is manipulated; they never replace native operation ids, host authority, or effect semantics.

verbs.HOLD: retain the exact addressed focus; focus is not an effect
verbs.TURN: view, navigation, offer, orientation, or other non-EFFECT native move
verbs.RELEASE: explicit host-native EFFECT boundary; the carrier still cannot dispatch it
verbs.RETURN: exact continuation closure to the recorded caller context

invariants: native move id, label, authority, target and HOST_NATIVE_ONLY dispatch remain visible
shared verbs create no mutation authority
one carrier still exposes at most three native moves
RETURN remains distinct from BACK, UNDO, REWIND, REVERT and RESET
hosts may remain unequal; the shared action surface is a projection only
